title: Command Center, App Shell, integración visual y demo operativa
mergePolicy: Do not merge before independent Claude and Antigravity reviews, visual evidence, and green CI on the same final SHA.

implementation.appShell: Shared responsive navigation for implemented 2J modules; preserves module hashes and displays permission-based navigation.
implementation.commandCenter: GET /api/dashboard/command-center aggregates today's calendar, clients, attention, economics, team and unread communications from existing domain tables.
implementation.globalSearch: GET /api/search covers active clients, professionals and active services only; no messages, health or document response content.
implementation.demo: Explicit additive and repeat-safe synthetic seed, restricted to development/test, loopback PostgreSQL and database name 2j_demo. Never runs on API startup.
implementation.quickActions: Permission-filtered navigation links into existing modules; no fake create/payment/send behaviors.

security.authorization: Every read-model block and global search group is gated server-side using existing capabilities.
security.cache: Command Center and search replies are marked Cache-Control: no-store.
security.sensitiveData: No client messages, health responses, PAR-Q answers, or document contents are returned by the read models.
security.demoProfile: LOCAL_DEMO_ROLE is development-only and loopback-bound; not production authentication.

postgres.evidence: PostgreSQL 17 isolated disposable databases; 13 checksummed migrations verified.

demoSeed.evidence: 12 clients, 12 client events, 1 session, 3 reservations, 1 waitlist row after both runs.

dependencyAudit.evidence: pnpm audit --audit-level high: no known vulnerabilities.

scopeGuard: No 2jfitnessapp changes, no duplicated training/Búnker/Health, no production credentials, no module feature expansion, no PR merge.
